correctness.rationale: A full analytic graph-distance-four expansion uses the exact negative fourth Taylor coefficient of 1/(1+z+z²/2); the distance-four matrix power is a positive shortest-walk count. The exact-integer package enumerates all 31 connected simple unweighted isomorphism classes through five vertices, verifies 644 adjugate polynomial sign checks, and verifies the precise rational P5 formula and rational isolation of its unique positive threshold. Positive definiteness of the denominator and block decomposition extend checks to all real timesteps and disconnected graphs. The eventual-positive statement follows from spectral convergence to the positive nullspace projector.

value.rationale: It identifies the first graph size and exact graph on which a standard second-order L-stable rational diffusion update loses nonnegative-cone invariance, quantifies a complete small-step failure and large-step recovery window, and proves the infinite-family graph-distance mechanism. This is a motivated sharp boundary for timestep selection and graph heat propagation, beyond a scalar stability test or an isolated numerical counterexample.
